an3.60:1.1: 61 athakho saṃgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an3.60:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saṃgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.60:1.5: tatra bho gotama yo ceva yaññaṃ yajati yo ca yajāpeti sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti yadidaṃ yaññādhikaraṇaṃ
an3.60:1.6: yo panāyaṃ bho gotama yassa vā tassa vā kulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ekamattānaṃ dameti ekamattānaṃ sameti ekamattānaṃ parinibbāpeti evamassāyaṃ ekasārīrikā puññapaṭipadā hoti yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇanti.
an3.60:2.1: tenahi brāhmaṇa taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi
an3.60:2.3: idha tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
an3.60:2.5: etthāyaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā yathā paṭipanno ahaṃ anuttaraṃ brahmacariyogadhaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedemi
an3.60:2.6: etha tumhepi tathā paṭipajjatha yathā paṭipannā tumhepi anuttaraṃ brahmacariyogadhaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathāti
an3.60:2.7: iti ayaṃ ceva satthā dhammaṃ deseti pare ca tathattāya paṭipajjanti tāni kho pana honti anekānipi satāni anekānipi sahassāni anekānipi satasahassāni
an3.60:3.2: iccāyaṃ evaṃ sante ekasārīrikā vā puññapaṭipadā hoti anekasārīrikā vā yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇanti.
an3.60:3.3: iccāyaṃpi bho gotama evaṃ sante anekasārīrikā puññapaṭipadā hoti yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇanti.

an3.60:19.2: na kho brāhmaṇa ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇiṃ satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni athakho bhiyyova ye bhikkhū imehi tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgatāti.
an3.60:19.3: kahaṃ pana bho gotama etarahi te bhikkhū viharantīti.
an3.60:20.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama

an3.60:20.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṃghañca
an3.60:20.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
